captions.instagram:
What is inertia?

Why do you lurch when the bus brakes, and how does a coin drop neatly into a glass when you flick the card away? Push carts, yank a tablecloth, spin a skater, hang a bicycle wheel from a string, weigh an astronaut without weight, and test the most precise coincidence in physics.

→ Same push, different mass: the heavier cart speeds up more slowly. a = F ÷ m.
→ Yank the cloth fast and the plate barely moves: inertia keeps it where it was.
→ The bus brakes, but nothing has touched you yet: you keep going and lurch forward.
→ Brake at 0.8 g and friction can’t hold an unstrapped crate: it slides into the cab.
→ Pull the arms in and a skater spins nearly four times faster: L = I ω stays the same.

Play with it yourself. It's free and open source: glassbox-production-fd52.up.railway.app/inertiaclear (link in bio)

youtubeLong.title: What is inertia? (interactive explainer)
youtubeLong.description:
Why do you lurch when the bus brakes, and how does a coin drop neatly into a glass when you flick the card away? Push carts, yank a tablecloth, spin a skater, hang a bicycle wheel from a string, weigh an astronaut without weight, and test the most precise coincidence in physics.

▶ Play with the interactive version: https://glassbox-production-fd52.up.railway.app/e/inertiaclear/
⌘ Source code (MIT): https://github.com/bdeeps/inertiaclear

In this video:
• Hard to budge. Inertia is how hard it is to change something's motion, and mass, in kilograms, measures it: the same force gives half the acceleration to twice the mass, a = F ÷ m.
• Riding. When a bus brakes, you keep going until something pushes you back with F = m a: about 180 N for a 60 kg passenger at 3 m/s².
• Spinning. For turning, inertia is the moment of inertia I = Σ m r².
• Measuring mass. A spring scale measures weight and reads a sixth on the Moon; a balance compares masses and reads true, but fails in orbit.
• Myths and limits. Things don't naturally slow down: friction stops them, and on ice a heavy sledge slides as far as a light one.
